answer: An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 4 such diverse attestations are required. Buying 4 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the farming party's cost, and each one has to keep a yarrow record clean through the copper check. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce an umber signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 40 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
